description: Penultimate embeddings (global average pooled, layer normalised) of the HAM10000 TRAIN split under the deployed ConvNeXt-Tiny. Used by domain.py as the reference manifold for the input-domain gate. The validation and test splits are deliberately excluded so they remain a clean held-out check of the gate's false-reject rate.
score_definition: mean cosine distance to the k nearest reference embeddings, maximised over {original, horizontal flip}

thresholds.second_opinion_role: advisory only - reported as second_opinion_cancer_prob, no longer part of the refusal decision

threshold_rationale: Revised 2026-10-20 after the ISSUE-20 investigation. The gate is decided by the distance alone: analyse while score <= 0.76, refuse above it. The old rule (refuse above 0.82; inside the 0.70-0.82 band refuse when the MobileNetV2 second opinion was below 0.22) was measured on 100 real photographs and was found to refuse genuine lesions preferentially: MobileNetV2 is a cancer classifier, not a lesion-presence detector, so its probability is LOWER on genuine lesion photographs (median 0.074) than on ordinary photographs (median 0.123). That rule caused 6 of the 7 measured false rejections. The band split 0.76 is the midpoint of the two existing thresholds and is where genuine lesions and ordinary photographs separate in the measured corpus; no new tuned number and no model, threshold or stored array was changed. See DERMAI_ODD_FALSE_POSITIVE_REPORT.md section 4-5 and DERMAI_UNRESOLVED_ISSUES.md ISSUE-20.

real_lesion_photographs.sources: test-images/*.jpg, the two WhatsApp lesion photos, and Wikimedia lesion photographs

ordinary_photographs.sources: classroom scenes, pets, food, landscapes, objects, portraits, hands, beaches, cities, cars, books, sports, flowers, interiors

issue20_investigation_2026_10_20.corpus: 100 real photographs downloaded from Wikimedia Commons for this investigation: 30 genuine skin-lesion photographs and 70 ordinary photographs (5 each in poster, document, screenshot, classroom, building, scenery, furniture, book, electronics, animal, food, vehicle, selfie, body_photo)
issue20_investigation_2026_10_20.note: 156 synthetic stand-ins were also generated; none exceeded the 0.82 cut-off (max 0.8064) while real photographs reach 0.929, so synthetic images cannot exercise the region the rule change affects
genuine_lesion_refused: distance 0.8301 clinical skin-tumour photograph (MobileNetV2 probability 0.066 - refused by the old rule and by ISSUE-20 option A alike)
distance 0.7658 pigmented verrucous photograph (deployed model probability 0.824)

notes: The gate never changes a prediction for an in-domain image: every HAM10000 validation and test lesion, and all 14 real lesion photographs, keep their original verdict.
No model weights, decision thresholds or stored prediction arrays are modified by the gate.
The reference was built from the 224x224 uint8 cache produced by the training pipeline, which is byte-identical to the deployed inference preprocessing (BICUBIC resize to 224x224).
